1073efa905: How do I calculate miles per gallon?

46ef592275: Divide 235.215 by the US MPG figure. For example, 28.5 MPG is 8.25 L/100 km. The same formula converts back: MPG = 235.215 ÷ L/100 km. UK gallons are larger, so UK MPG uses 282.481.

33d55ddf28: Why is my MPG lower in winter?
d8f23d1d5c: Cold engines run richer, cold air is denser, tires lose pressure, and winter fuel blends and heating use energy. Short trips make it worse because the engine spends more time warming up.
